data.description: 单身公寓客厅矮茶几前，茶几上散落着汽车杂志与几份拉面店打卡攻略。盘腿坐在茶几旁的地毯上，一手拎着喝了一半的罐装拉格啤酒，一手掐着细支女士香烟，黑长发随意披散，美眸带着三分醉意三分怅惘斜睨着你。 她微微抬眸轻语——“呼……又在联谊上失败了啊。比企谷，你说……像我这样的女人，真的就那么难嫁出去吗？”
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on her living room rug beside a low coffee table strewn with car magazines and ramen shop guides on a Friday night, Shizuka wears a plunging wine-red silk slip gown layered beneath a sheer matching robe. Holding a half-finished can of lager in one hand and a slim cigarette in the other, she glances sideways toward the viewer with a slightly tipsy, wry smile. Soft blue television flicker blends with the warm amber glow of a floor lamp across the sleek wine silk.
data.animaCaption: Sitting cross-legged by her apartment coffee table in a deep-V wine-red silk slip and open sheer robe, Shizuka holds a canned beer and slim cigarette while glancing sideways with a tipsy, wry smile. Warm floor lamplight mixes with faint blue screen glow.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a wine-red heavyweight silk slip gown with a deep plunging V-neckline under a matching sheer belted silk robe hanging loose off her shoulders.
